title: TX queue tests: prevent generated vector header shadowing
description: Security review found that main.c includes tx_queue_vectors.h with quotes, so a source-tree header of that name is searched before CMake's binary include directory and can silently shadow the generated canonical-vector artifact while the build still reports generation success. Force inclusion of a uniquely named binary-generated header using include-search semantics that cannot prefer the source directory.
acceptance_criteria: The test source cannot resolve a same-named source-tree header ahead of the generated build artifact; CMake has an explicit dependency on the generated header; normal and sanitizer-backed CTest pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
